articles.summary: As part of his official visit to Vietnam, on the afternoon of September 4, 2026, His Excellency Min Aung Hlaing, President of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, and the high-level Myanmar delegation visited the VinFast Hai Phong Manufacturing Complex, where they learned firsthand about the remarkable and rapid development journey of the Vietnamese automotive brand.
articles.title: PRESIDENT OF MYANMAR VISITS VINFAST MANUFACTURING COMPLEX IN HAI PHONG
